resources.string: Clearing discards unsaved edits, deletes the host preference for every scope and attempts to remove the installed engine proxy. Docker may restart and interrupt containers. Clear it?
Saving affects the selected outbound scopes for all users. Installing, replacing or removing the engine proxy may restart Docker and interrupt running containers. Apply these settings?
Build arguments are applied, but container loopback points to the container itself. Use a host address reachable from the container.
Server passes the proxy through its Docker build environment; no host configuration is needed.
Restart Docker Desktop manually on the host.
The actual Docker Desktop upstream differs from the saved preference.
Host configuration was written; effect is pending a Docker daemon restart.
These edits have not been saved. Continuing discards them.
These host settings affect outbound requests for all users on the current server. The phone network stays unchanged.
An empty HTTPS proxy reuses the HTTP proxy. Use an http:// or https:// URL.
The host resolves the listener from Mihomo settings. Changing its port does not install new Docker daemon settings; read actual scope status and confirm a new outbound save when needed.
Separate hosts, domains or addresses with commas. Addresses refer to the server, not the phone.
The proxy URL or NO_PROXY format is invalid.
The engine change requires restart confirmation.
The Docker daemon returned no proxy information; effect could not be verified.
Server cannot write Docker Desktop settings.
Docker Desktop settings are invalid; the file was left unchanged.
Docker Desktop settings are locked. Quit it and retry.
Docker Desktop did not retain the written settings. Verify on the host.
Docker Desktop settings were not found.
Docker Desktop settings could not be read.
Docker Desktop could not be stopped; settings were not replaced.
Engine proxy configuration failed. Check host configuration and permissions.
The saved preference has not been installed on the Docker engine.
The host privileged helper is unavailable. Repair it and retry.
The managed Mihomo listener is unavailable. Start or repair it on the host, or switch to a custom proxy.
This host platform cannot configure the engine proxy automatically.
The host cannot decrypt the saved proxy settings.
The write result is unknown. Refresh to verify host state before another change.
Host settings read back. Review each scope below.

Image queries and runtime downloads resolve the saved source and NO_PROXY. This endpoint reports no connectivity or success result for those requests. An engine failure does not imply failure in other scopes.
